FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Artisan Gallery and Supply, we are dedicated to providing a diverse selection of fine art and quality art supplies, focusing on both local and emerging artists. Our core operations include the curation of professionally appraised artworks, ensuring that our inventory reflects accurate valuation for our clientele and insurance purposes. We host regular exhibitions and community events that foster appreciation for the arts in our area. Additionally, our art supply store is committed to the safety and satisfaction of our customers, implementing comprehensive inventory management and regular documentation reviews. We maintain stringent compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations while actively practicing loss prevention to protect our valuable inventory and enhance the overall customer experience. Robust security measures are in place to safeguard high-value artworks, and our staff undergoes regular training in safety protocols and customer relations.

Our art gallery curates a diverse selection of unique pieces and regularly updates our stock based on customer interest and trends, but we do not conduct formal appraisals of our inventory.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Artisan Gallery and Supply does not own or operate any other business locations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Artisan Gallery and Supply has experienced no reported losses since the business was established. The inventory is maintained with annual appraisals; however, there was a minor incident in February 2023 involving water damage during a heavy storm, which resulted in approximately $2,000 in losses due to damaged supplies. This claim was promptly addressed and resolved. The overall status is clear with no pending claims.
